seed.name: drifted-act
seed.purpose: Adds two whole numbers for its judge to check. A worked example: admitted at birth, but its act has drifted, so the guard withholds every wrong total.

lane.accepts: two whole numbers to add, or a claim that they add up to a total
lane.refuses: anything that is not two whole numbers

interface.out: act: the claim {"sum":[a,b],"claim":n}; judge: verified, unverified or refused

judge.what: a + b equals the claim, exactly
